newsitem.title: MEXICO: RESEARCH ALERT - Empaques Ponderosa downgraded.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Empaques Ponderosa downgraded.

text.p: Caspian said on Tuesday that it had downgraded Empaques Ponderosa to market performer from buy.
--"We are downgrading our rating on Empaques Ponderosa to market performer from buy, as a result of its strong price performance," the company said.

-- "The company's operating outlook remains bright, with second half 1997 results expected to benefit from the company 's 30,000 tons per annum boxboard expansion, and from continued strong growth at Aluprint, its flexible packaging arm," Caspian said.
-- But it added that Empaques Ponderosa's 145 percent gain in price over the last year appears to have discounted the company's expected continued strong operating performance.
